title: The American Jewish Experience: A Reflection in this 250th Year of the US
venue: New York Jewish Week / JTA (My Jewish Learning Hub)
description: Keeping It Sacred hosts Rabbi Heather Miller for an Election Day program reflecting on the American Jewish experience over the past 250 years. The session marks America’s 250th anniversary with an exploration of the history of Jewish life in the United States.
